Returns a single follow-up by its unique identifier.
All dates and times are church-local wall-clock: `date` is the scheduled date,
`completed_on` is when the follow-up was marked done.

put.description:
Replaces a follow-up's editable fields and returns the updated follow-up. This is a full
replacement: an omitted `action_id` or `notes` is cleared, an omitted `type` becomes
"visit" and an omitted `status` becomes "pending".
- For a non-recurring follow-up, `date` is required in church-local `yyyy-MM-dd` format.
  Setting `status: "done"` with a future `date` moves the date to today.
- Changing `status` from pending to done records the API key's owner as the person who
  completed it; setting it back to pending clears that.
- Assignees must be in GET /follow-ups/assignable-members, except people already
  assigned to this follow-up, who may be kept.
- Removed assignees are unassigned; newly added assignees with a user account are
  notified while the follow-up is pending.
- For an occurrence of a recurring follow-up, omit `date`: the stored occurrence date
  is used automatically and cannot be changed. Any supplied `date` is ignored, even if
  it is not a valid date. `start_time` and `end_time` apply to the stored occurrence date.
  Marking the latest occurrence done schedules the next one.
Returns 404 when the follow-up does not exist.

delete.description:
Deletes a follow-up. Deleting the latest occurrence of a recurring follow-up schedules the
next occurrence, so the series continues; the rest of the series is unaffected.
Returns 404 when the follow-up does not exist.

type.description: Account type: asset or liability. Income/expense classification lives on categories, not accounts.

balance.description: Current running balance (income minus expenses over all non-voided transactions, beginning balances included). Present only when requested via include=balance.

id.description: ID of the referenced resource. Null when the reference is name-only (e.g. a free-text payee with no payee record).

parent_category_id.description: ID of the parent category; null for top-level categories. The hierarchy is at most two levels deep.

balance.description: Net fund balance across all accounts (income minus expenses over all non-voided transaction lines). Present only when requested via include=balance.

is_1099_eligible.description: Whether this payee is eligible for 1099 reporting.

type.description: income or expense. Amounts are always positive; signed value = income ? +amount : -amount.

amount.description: Header total: the sum of the line amounts. Positive except on fund transfers, whose offsetting lines sum to 0.

payee.description: Payee of the transaction. id is null when the payee is free-text only; the whole field is null when there is no payee.

is_voided.description: Voided transactions contribute zero to every balance and report total.

is_fund_transfer.description: True for a fund-to-fund transfer: one transaction with a negative line on the source fund and a positive line on the destination fund (header amount 0, no categories).

is_beginning_balance.description: True for an opening-balance row. Seeds the account balance; excluded from period-activity reports.

lines.description: Split lines; every transaction has at least one. Each line is assigned to a category and fund.

amount.description: Line amount; direction comes from the transaction's type. Positive except on fund transfers, where the source-fund line is negative and the destination-fund line positive.

category.description: Income/expense category of this line. Null on beginning-balance, fund-transfer, and account-transfer lines, which carry no category.

occurred_at.description:
When the action actually happened, as the church's local wall-clock time.
Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss (e.g. 2026-08-09T09:14:23). Fractional seconds are accepted
and truncated. A UTC offset (Z or +03:00) is rejected - convert to the church's timezone
before sending; do not simply strip the offset, or the time will be stored wrong.
Defaults to the current church-local time. Offline clients pass the recorded time when
they sync. Responses use the same format, so values round-trip unchanged.

checked_in_at.description: Church-local wall-clock time, ISO-8601 without a UTC offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss). Interpret it in the church's configured timezone, not the caller's.

checked_out_at.description: Church-local wall-clock time, ISO-8601 without a UTC offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss). Interpret it in the church's configured timezone, not the caller's. Null until the person is checked out.

expected.description:
Size of the occurrence's expected pool. Who that covers depends on the event's attendee type:
members of the target groups, individually invited people, form submitters, or every member
of the church.

attended.description: People with a member record who were marked as attended.

absent.description: Expected people with no attendance recorded.

guests_attended.description:
Untracked guests added manually by an admin. They attended but have no member record,
so they are counted here only and never in expected or attended.

total_attended.description: attended + guests_attended — the total physical headcount.

groups.description: Per-group attendance breakdown. Not present when ?include=groups is not passed. People in multiple groups are counted once per group. Group totals may exceed overall totals.

created_on.description: The date and time when this record was created in the database. THIS IS NOT THE ACTUAL PAYMENT DATE..

paid_on.description: The actual date when the payment was made.

reference_id.description: Client-supplied reference (idempotency key) sent when the contribution was created via the API.

organization_id.description: The organization that owns this contribution: the church or one of its ministries. Matches the ids from GET /organizations.

reference_id.description: Optional client reference (idempotency key), unique per church account. Matching is case-insensitive. Posting a reference_id that already exists is rejected as a duplicate, which makes retries safe.

date.description: Required scheduled date in church-local yyyy-MM-dd format.

person_id.description: ID of the person to follow up with.

assignee_ids.description: Person IDs of the people responsible for the follow-up, from GET /follow-ups/assignable-members. At least one is required. Assignees with a user account are notified while the follow-up is pending.

start_time.description: Start time on the follow-up date, church-local HH:mm or HH:mm:ss. Defaults to 00:00.

end_time.description: End time on the follow-up date, church-local HH:mm or HH:mm:ss. Required when start_time is provided, and must not be earlier than it. Defaults to 00:00.

action_id.description: Follow-up action (category) ID from GET /follow-ups/actions. Omit for no action.

oneOf.description: "pending" or "done". Defaults to "pending". Marking it done records the API key's owner as the person who completed it.

name.description: Group name. Must be unique within the organization.

description.description: Group description. Rich text - HTML is accepted and stored as given.

privacy.description: Who can see the group: "internal" (visible only to users with access to this feature), "members" (visible in the Member Portal), or "public" (visible to anyone).

join_request_option.description: Whether members may request to join: "open", "closed", or "approval_required". Defaults to "closed".

is_visible_to_non_members.description: Show this group to members who are not in it. Always forced to true when privacy is "public". Only takes effect when privacy is "members" or "public".

is_members_visible.description: Show the group's members in the Member Portal. Only takes effect when privacy is "members" or "public", and additionally requires the Online Member Directory to be enabled in the account's Member Role settings.

is_group_leaders_visible.description: Show the group's leaders in the Member Portal. Only takes effect when privacy is "members" or "public", and additionally requires the Online Member Directory to be enabled in the account's Member Role settings.

is_chat_enabled.description: Enable group chat. Requires an active group chat add-on (or a branded mobile app subscription); the request is rejected with 400 otherwise.

birth_date.description: ISO 8601 date (yyyy-MM-dd). Use '1776' if the year is unknown (e.g. '1776-11-10'); otherwise send a full date or null.

marriage_date.description: ISO 8601 date (yyyy-MM-dd). Use '1776' if the year is unknown (e.g. '1776-11-10'); otherwise send a full date or null.

body.description: Post content as rich-text HTML, exactly as the editor produces it. Required, maximum 5 MB.

status.description: "draft" stores the post without publishing it; "published" makes it live right away.

visibility.description: Who can see the post: "internal" (only users with permission to this feature), "members" (also visible in the Member Portal to signed-in members), or "public" (visible to anyone, no login required). Raised to "members" automatically when the post is published with notify_members set to true.

published_on.description: Publish date in the church's timezone — send a plain date (yyyy-MM-dd), not a UTC instant. Defaults to today when status is "published" and no date is sent, and is stored as null when status is "draft". A future date schedules the post: members and guests see it only from that date on (this API returns it right away), and the member notification goes out that morning — see notify_members.

allow_comments.description: Whether members can comment on the post. Defaults to false.

allow_likes.description: Whether members can like the post. Defaults to false.

notify_members.description: Sends a push notification announcing the post. Only takes effect when status is "published". Sent immediately unless published_on is a future date, in which case it goes out on that date at 09:00 church time. Defaults to false.

category_ids.description: Ids of the post categories to assign. Every id must belong to this organization — one unknown id rejects the whole request. Defaults to an empty list (no categories).

move_to_fund_id.description: The fund ID to move contributions to. Required only if the fund has contributions.

move_to_payment_method_id.description: The payment method ID to move contributions to. Required only if the payment method has contributions.

description.description:
Event description as rich-text HTML, exactly as entered in the editor. Null when not set.
Sanitize before rendering it in a browser.

recurrence.description:
How the event repeats. Null when the event does not repeat,
and also when a recurring event's stored rule cannot be parsed.

location.description: Where the event takes place. Null when no location details were entered at all.

visibility.description:
Who can see this event:
- "internal": visible only to users with permission to access events in this ministry.
- "members": visible in the Member Portal to logged-in members.
- "public":  visible to anyone, no login required.

image_url.description:

name.description: Venue name as typed by the church (e.g. "Main Hall"). Null when not set.

formatted_address.description: Full address from geocoding, set when the location was picked on the map. Null when the venue was only typed by hand.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Null when the location was never geocoded.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Null when the location was never geocoded.

occurrence_id.description:
Schedule record id of this occurrence, as a numeric string. Always a real record here,
never one of the synthetic ids the occurrences endpoint returns for virtual occurrences.

start.description: Start of the occurrence in local church time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.

end.description: End of the occurrence in local church time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.

groups.description: Per-group attendance breakdown for this occurrence. Not present when ?include=groups is not passed. People in multiple groups are counted once per group. Group totals may exceed overall totals.

from.description: Start of the range the statistics cover, echoed from the request. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

to.description: End of the range the statistics cover, echoed from the request. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

summary.description: Rollup across every occurrence in the range.

occurrences.description:
One entry per occurrence in the range, ordered by date. Only materialized occurrences appear —
a virtual occurrence has no attendance records, so it is not represented here even though
the occurrences endpoint lists it.

occurrences_count.description: Number of occurrences in the range that this rollup covers.

expected.description:
Expected counts summed across every occurrence in the range — not a count of distinct people.
Someone expected at 4 occurrences contributes 4. This is what attendance-rate KPIs compare
attended against, per service.

attended.description: Attended counts summed across every occurrence in the range, not distinct people.

absent.description: Absent counts summed across every occurrence in the range, not distinct people.

guests_attended.description: Guest counts summed across every occurrence in the range.

total_attended.description: attended + guests_attended, summed across the period.

recurrence_pattern.description: Raw iCalendar RRULE (RFC 5545) the other fields are derived from, e.g. `FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=MO,WE`. Numbers may be zero-padded (`INTERVAL=002`), and `UNTIL` is church-local despite the `Z` suffix - prefer `end_date`.

interval.description: Repeat every N periods (e.g. 2 = every 2 weeks).

weekly.description: Populated only when frequency is weekly.

monthly.description: Populated only when frequency is monthly.

yearly.description: Populated only when frequency is yearly.

end_date.description: Date the series ends (YYYY-MM-DD). null means the series repeats indefinitely.

start_time.description:
Time of day the event starts, in HH:mm:ss 24-hour format (local church time).
null when all_day is true — all-day events have no defined start time.
For recurring events this time is reused on every occurrence in the series.

end_time.description:
Time of day the event ends, in HH:mm:ss 24-hour format (local church time).
null when all_day is true — all-day events have no defined end time.
For recurring events this time is reused on every occurrence in the series.

duration_days.description:
Number of additional calendar days the event spans beyond its start date.
0 = the event starts and ends on the same calendar day.
1 = the event ends on the next calendar day (e.g. starts 23:00, ends 01:00).
Use start_date + duration_days to derive the end date of any occurrence.

person_mobile.description: The person's mobile number, or null when none is set.

start_time.description: Scheduled start time of day (church-local, HH:mm:ss).

action_id.description: The follow-up action (category), or null when none is set. See GET /follow-ups/actions.

assignees.description: The people responsible for carrying out this follow-up.

is_recurring.description: True when this follow-up is an instance of a recurring series.

Unique identifier for this occurrence. Use this value as-is when calling occurrence endpoints.
The format depends on the materialized field:
  true  — a numeric string representing the schedule record ID in the database (e.g. "12345").
  false — a generated string, as no database record exists for this virtual occurrence.

title.description: Title of this occurrence. Falls back to the parent event's name when the occurrence has no title of its own.

description.description:
Description of this occurrence as rich-text HTML. Falls back to the parent event's
description when the occurrence has none of its own. Sanitize before rendering.

Start of the occurrence in local church time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.
All-day events return a date only (yyyy-MM-dd) with no time component.

end.description:
End of the occurrence in local church time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.
All-day events return a date only (yyyy-MM-dd) with no time component.

materialized.description:
True when a real record exists.
False when computed on-the-fly from the recurrence rule.

image_url.description:
CDN URL of the occurrence image, or null if no image is available.
For materialized occurrences, the schedule's own image is used when set;
otherwise the parent event's image is returned.
For virtual occurrences, the parent event's image is always returned.
Append CDN resize parameters (e.g. ?width=900&quality=80) on the client as needed.

location.description:
Where this occurrence takes place. A materialized occurrence returns its own location when one
was set for that date only; otherwise, and for every virtual occurrence, the parent event's
location is returned. Null when no location details were entered at all.

group_id.description:
Group identifier, or null for the "Ungrouped" bucket — expected people who belong to no group.
That bucket is always present, even when its counts are zero.

organizations.description: Present only when include_organizations=true. Omitted otherwise.
